messages:
ashley: Quick readiness ping — prepping mpt-22b-v2 for Dedicated canary. Small checklist: weights location, tokenizer quirks, quant config pass, and calibration data size. Can people ack?

kiran: I pulled the weights, path looks correct.
`gs://redwood-models/mpt-22b/v2/awq-quantized/sha256:ab12...ef`
I did a quick checksum and it matches the manifest.

mike: ops note: the weight bucket has lifecycle rules that might transition older artifacts to cold storage in 30d. Are we pinning the canary to the exact object? If so we should copy to dedicated-serving-bucket.

ashley: @mike yes we'll pin. copying now to `s3://dedicated-serving/mpt-22b/v2/canary/` then update model config.

deploy-bot: deploy check: model artifact copy job queued (job id: 89c3). ETA ~2m.

ashley: tokenizer weirdness — during offline tokenization tests we saw <pad> id mismatch between the model config and tokenizer.json (model expects pad=0, tokenizer.json had pad=1). That caused some off-by-one generation probs in smoke tests.

eva: That explains the short hallucinations in the evals. We should update `tokenizer.json` and add an explicit `pad_token_id` override in the serving config: `tokenizer_overrides: {"pad_token_id":0}`. Also note that sentencepiece training used legacy BOS/CLS ordering — handle with mapping.

kiran: I tried an end-to-end with `--tokenizer-override` and the perplexity on the calibration set improved ~2.3%. Calibration set = 3k prompts (curated), FYI.

ashley: OK re: quant config — the validator flagged an FP8 flag that we don't support in AWQ pipeline. Current config snippet: 
```json
{"quant":{"type":"awq","backend":"awq-optimized","bits":8,"fp_format":"fp8"}}
```
Validator says: "unsupported fp_format for backend awq-optimized". We need either remove fp8 or switch to a backend that supports it.

eva: For this model AWQ-4/5 (4-bit/5-bit) is the recommended tradeoff. FP8 is experimental and only available on GPU kernels in staging. My recommendation: use `bits:4` + calibrated per-layer scales, then run accuracy smoke. If team wants experimental FP8, do a separate canary.

sam: QA/ops note: calibration data location is `s3://model-calib/mpt-22b/v2/3k/`. We should persist the exact split and seed in the run metadata so results are reproducible.

mike: Copy to dedicated bucket done (job 89c3 succeeded). Updated model config in staging to point to pinned object.

ashley: Sounds like action items: (1) kiran to push tokenizer override + commit hash, (2) eva to prepare AWQ-4 config and expected regression thresholds, (3) sam to snapshot calibration split metadata, (4) mike to promote pinned artifact to canary path. Please reply with :thumbsup: when done.

kiran: pushed tokenizer override and config PR -> #4289. Added tests that assert pad_token_id mapping. :thumbsup:
